title: Agentic Factory Audit Evidence Pack Index Schema
description: Standard schema for continuous DHF, AI Transparency, and SDLC evidence packs produced by Agentic Factory (AF-AUDIT-PACK-001).

schema.description: Version identifier for the audit evidence pack schema.

built_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the pack was sealed.

task_id.description: Task or sprint identifier within the program.

paq_enabled.description: Whether Project Assurance & Quality (PAQ) fail-closed gating was active.

claim_boundary.description: Formal boundary notice stating this pack facilitates evidence and does not substitute for regulatory clearance or human sign-off.

cqc_ref.description: Reference path to the governing Customer Quality Contract.

msa_exhibit_ref.description: Reference path to the governing Master Services Agreement / EULA Exhibit.

pre_signoff_flags.description: Deterministic and advisory audit flags evaluated prior to human sign-off.

id.description: Stable flag identifier for automated gating.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the audit finding.

files.description: Cryptographically hashed manifest of all controlled and generated files in the bundle.

path.description: Destination path within the evidence pack bundle.

relpath.description: Normalized relative path for archive unpacking.

sha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 hex digest of the file contents.

source.description: Source origin classification (e.g. controlled, generated, program).

receipts.description: Count of verified gate receipts included in the pack.

files.description: Total number of files in the bundle.

transparency_rows.description: Count of AI Transparency Register entries.
